sloka: स तत्राभिहतस्तेन सुग्रीवो वानरर्षभः।मुष्टिं संवर्तयामास वज्रकल्पं महाबलः ।। ६.७६.८९ ।।
transliteration: sa tatrābhihatastena sugrīvo vānararṣabhaḥ।muṣṭiṁ saṁvartayāmāsa vajrakalpaṁ mahābalaḥ ।। 6.76.89 ।।

translations.english: Then by the speed of the hit on Sugriva's chest by Kumbha's fist a flame burst forth like the flame of Meru Mountain.
